metadata.description: Commodore 64 development skills built on the c64-ready emulator: build with KickAssembler, verify with frame-exact headless runs, play the result in the browser.

plugins.name: c64-skills
plugins.description: Claude writes C64 assembly with KickAssembler and proves it works in the c64-ready emulator: frame-exact repeatable runs, scripted joystick and keyboard input, breakpoints by label and screenshots, with nothing to install beyond Node and Java. Then it hands you a build you can play in your browser.
